messages:

Subject: Re: Onboarding information and next steps

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. Attached are the certificate of insurance and a subcontractor list you asked for. A couple of notes:

- The COI lists Redwood Inference as "certificate holder" at the address you provided; our broker didn't apply an endorsement to add Additional Insured by default.
- We do maintain cyber coverage with a $2M limit; the insurer provided a policy summary (attached).
- We can request an endorsement to add Redwood as Additional Insured and a waiver of subrogation, but it will take 5–7 business days and an endorsement fee of $150 from the broker.

Attachments: [EdgeWorks_COI.pdf (PDF, 220KB)], [EdgeWorks-Subcontractor-List.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)], [EdgeWorks-Commercial-Liability-Declaration.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Let me know if the COI as-is will let you move forward with a conditional PO, or whether you need us to confirm the endorsement now.

Best,
Elena Costa
Head of Contracts, EdgeWorks Inc.
elena@edgeworks.io
+1 415-555-0123
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Elena Costa <elena@edgeworks.io>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding information and next steps

Elena —

Thanks for sending these over so quickly. A couple of quick clarifying questions from procurement:

1) Is the Additional Insured endorsement available on an Occurrence basis? Our legal team sometimes requires it be Primary and Non-Contributory depending on scope. If it can be made Primary/Non-Contributory that's ideal.
2) For cyber coverage: does the policy include coverage for third-party data breach notification costs? Our SOC/compliance reviewers will ask.
3) Can you confirm whether any subcontractors on that list perform engineering or have code-deploy permissions? We have a shorter path if subcontractors are strictly professional services.

If endorsement procurement will take >5 business days then we can provisionally accept the COI for a Conditional PO (PO to follow once finance completes payment setup), but we need the endorsement before the first renewal or go-live.

CC'ing Grace from Risk and Priyom from Procurement to align on next steps.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-01T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding information and next steps

Dylan — quick notes from Risk after a first pass: 

- COI looks standard; Limits meet our baseline minimums for commercial general liability but the policy effective dates need to cover our expected pilot period (start 2025-10-20). Please confirm insurer policy period and whether retroactive dates exist for professional/cyber policies.
- Additional Insured: if EdgeWorks can provide Primary/Non-Contributory endorsement, that satisfies Legal for now. If they can only do Additional Insured on a secondary basis, Legal will request an exception and likely want a $/percentage holdback clause in the PO.
- Subcontractor list: a few vendors are flagged as "engineering support" (rows 3 and 7). Priyom, please treat those as needing elevated access controls checklist before provisioning.

Suggested path: issue a Conditional PO that covers non-production discovery work, require endorsement within 10 business days, and include a holdback clause that releases remaining payment upon endorsement confirmation. I'll draft language for the PO holdback.

- Grace
Director, Third-Party Risk | Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Elena Costa <elena@edgeworks.io>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-02T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: certificate scope clarifications & PO hold items

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. To keep timeline moving, we will: 

- Issue a Conditional PO that authorizes kickoff work (discovery and integration planning) with 30% of the initial milestone paid on receipt of invoice. Remaining 70% will be held until we receive confirmation of the Additional Insured endorsement or an approved risk exception.
- Please confirm by 2025-10-09 whether your broker can provide Primary/Non-Contributory Additional Insured and waiver of subrogation for Redwood Inference. If yes, please email the endorsement to contracts@redwood.ai and reply-all here so we can lift the hold.
- If EdgeWorks chooses to proceed with endorsement procurement, note that endorsements must reference: Redwood Inference, 120 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107 and list policy number exactly as on the COI.

Doc links: DocuSign starter for PO (https://docusign.com/edgeworks-po-2025). HubSpot deal id: DEAL-8732.

I'll route the Conditional PO to finance once Elena confirms.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
